card.name: End of section heading terms
card.fires_on: The last piece of a heading or sub-heading noun in a drug label, such as Tool, Dosages, Toxicities, Inhibitors or Reactions, right before the body text starts.

modes.label: Numbered section headings
modes.description: Final piece of a numbered warning or interaction heading, just before the paragraph begins.

modes.label: Unnumbered subheadings
modes.description: Last word of a subheading on dosing or device use, before the text under it.
modes.example: Maximum Recommended Dos<<ages>> In patients weighing <150 lb

modes.label: Interaction subheadings
modes.description: Ending of a drug-class name used as a subheading for interactions.
modes.example: Multiple Concomitant Weak CYP3A4 Inhib<<itors>> Concomitant use of multiple weak C
